title: Manual of the Azure Sword School
summary: The school's founding manual that teaches the azure edge from the first cut to its closing form for students of the sword affinity.

title: The Twin Hawk Sword Course
summary: A school course of paired hawk strokes from the first stoop to a closing form in which the blade falls like a hawk.

title: Course of the Paired Blades of Qi
summary: A school course that teaches two blades of qi as one weapon through guards and cuts to a closing form of twin strokes.

title: Canon of the Dual-Track Sword School
summary: A canon of the school that runs the body and the blade down two tracks of qi and closes on a form that binds both.

title: The Azure Sword Sovereign's Canon
summary: The school's highest canon that carries the azure sword from plain cuts to a sovereign closing form worked from the formed Core.

title: Manual of the Oath-Sworn Sword School
summary: The school's founding manual of a sword sworn to the oath that teaches the sworn line from the first cut to its closing form.

title: The Bearing Course of the Wind-Sworn
summary: A school course of the bearing taken and held through cuts and guards to a closing form that never leaves the line.

title: Course of the Unwalled Sword
summary: A school course of open sword work with no wall and no fixed guard that ends in a form where the edge has no bound.

title: Canon of the Long Oath Sword School
summary: A canon of the school that carries one oath across a long fight and closes on a form that the oath alone sustains.

title: The Sovereign Bearing Canon
summary: The school's highest canon that holds a sovereign bearing from the formed Core and closes on a form that no force can turn.
